results.title: What Is Stripe, and How Does It Work to Accept Payments? - NerdWallet
results.content:
However, these factors do not influence our editors' opinions or ratings, which are based on independent research and analysis. Our partners cannot pay us to guarantee favorable reviews. Here is a list of our partners.

# What Is Stripe, and How Does It Work to Accept Payments?

Stripe is a payment service provider that accepts credit cards, digital wallets and many other payment methods.

Written by [...] Stripe has a PCI compliance Level 1 certification. That means it undergoes an annual compliance report and routine security scans. Stripe encrypts all customers’ credit card numbers. And it stores decryption information separately. In other words, it can’t see credit card numbers without taking extra steps. All online transactions also need to happen over the more secure HTTPS network.

» MORE: Best payment processors for small businesses

Methodology [...] 1. The customer provides their card information, either online or in person.
2. Those card details enter Stripe’s payment gateway, which encrypts the data.
3. Stripe sends that data to the acquiring bank. It will process the transaction on the merchant’s behalf. In this step, Stripe serves as the merchant (with the business owner as a sub-merchant). This means Stripe users don’t have to set up a merchant account, which can be cumbersome.

results.title: Stripe, FedEx team on SMB lending
results.content: The FedEx effort follows Stripe’s purchase last week of embedded financing company Parafin, which also arranges loans for small businesses. Stripe plans to use the San Francisco-based startup to expand its lending for smaller firms. In the Sept. 30 news release about the Parafin acquisition, Stripe argued that small businesses are finding it difficult to access capital, citing a decreasing percentage of approved loans last year compared to 2015. [...] Stripe is partnering with global shipping giant FedEx to combine their data insights from logistics and financial infrastructure to create financing options for small businesses, the companies said Tuesday in a joint press release. [...] “Stripe will be better positioned to evaluate, approve, and deploy tailored funding more quickly than traditional lending processes, eliminating the friction for SMBs,” the release said. Stripe makes business loans through two partner banks.

results.title: Stripe's Acquisition Pace Has Accelerated In The Past Five Years, But Nothing Comes Close To Its Reported $53B PayPal Bet
results.content:
Stripe’s M&A pace has also accelerated sharply since 2020, Crunchbase data shows, with 13 of its 21 acquisitions announced since then.

Its recent strategy appears to be focused on stablecoins and crypto infrastructure — Bridge, Privy, Valora and PartyDAO — as well as on billing and money movement through Metronome, payment processing startup Lemon Squeezy and Orum. [...] With substantial private capital — it has raised some $10.4 billion since inception, per Crunchbase — Stripe has long been one of the most acquisitive venture-backed startups. It has made 21 known acquisitions since its 2010 inception, according to Crunchbase data. Only three have disclosed prices: stablecoin platform Bridge at $1.1 billion (2025), usage-based billing software startup Metronome at $1 billion (2026), and Nigerian payments startup Paystack at $200 million (2020). [...] Payments giant Stripe and private equity firm Advent International have teamed up to make an offer to buy troubled PayPal in a deal valued at more than $53 billion, Reuters reported Wednesday.

results.title: Stripe's $7.5 Billion Bet on the AI Model Routing Layer | The Motley Fool
results.content:
Fintech giant Stripe is acquiring OpenRouter, a leading artificial intelligence (AI) model gateway, in a deal reportedly worth $7.5 billion. That's nearly six times the $1.3 billion valuation estimated by The New York Times following its latest funding round in May. The premium is due in part to Stripe having outbid other tech players, including Databricks, for the company. [...] Stripe is adding another toll collector to its operation with its acquisition of OpenRouter, but it's paying a steep premium for the company.

ByBryan White – Aug 27, 2026 at 6:51PM EST

+Fool.comon

## Key Points [...] Both companies are toll collectors, and this acquisition will expand Stripe's currency base. Where it typically spends to grow its transaction volume, these tolls will rise on their own as AI adoption spreads. Stripe's fraud screening also helps prevent the stolen-card purchases and token reselling that plague small AI marketplaces.
